## Action-gated lookup
Any action-type other than pure explanation MUST:
- query MBMI for similar prior actions
- record hits or a bypass reason in BTS Decision v2

## Reuse
Reuse is permitted when:
- similarity >= threshold
- provenance constraints pass
- the reused node set is recorded in BTS
